body.zh: 大多数固体的溶解度随温度升高而增大。硝酸钾尤其明显：80 °C 时能溶解的量约为 20 °C 时的五倍。热饱和溶液降温后，装不下的溶质就会析出晶体。实验台用溶解度表逐温度插值，属教学近似。
body.en: Most solids dissolve better when hot. KNO₃ is dramatic: at 80 °C about five times as much dissolves as at 20 °C. Cooling a hot saturated solution forces the excess out as crystals. The lab interpolates a solubility table — a teaching approximation.
